host.label: Bridge host
host.description: Address the local bridge listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless you know why.

port.label: Bridge port
port.description: Must match the port in bridge.py and in the SPlayer-Next plugin (default 33550).

prefix.label: Text prefix
prefix.description: Shown before the lyric. Leave empty to show the text alone.

max_chars.label: Maximum characters
max_chars.description: Truncate the bar text after this many characters. 0 means no limit.

poll_ms.label: Poll interval (ms)
poll_ms.description: How often the widget asks the bridge for the current line.

extra_mode.label: Secondary line mode
extra_mode.description: Choose what the secondary line shows. Background/duet first prefers background or duet, then translation, then the next line.

hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
hide_when_idle.description: Hide the widget while the bridge is offline, nothing is playing, or there is no lyric.

show_when_paused.label: Keep lyric while paused
show_when_paused.description: Keep the last line visible when playback is paused instead of hiding the widget.

show_title_when_no_lyric.label: Show track title without lyrics
show_title_when_no_lyric.description: Display the song title during instrumental sections or when a track has no lyrics.
